--- PART 1/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report / "General cooperation advice says cooperate, forgive, repair. But to maximize, exploit always cooperators."
STRATEGY: Parent slot0 is a mostly cooperative, retaliatory IPD strategy; the trace simulates a new strategy that starts C, defects while the opponent has never defected, repairs after mutual defection, and punishes unprovoked defections. The trace changes the parent by adding early exploitation of always-cooperators and a short forgiveness window after its own defections.

--- PART 2/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "General advice says avoid permanent retaliation. Our strategy punishes one round then repairs, so it's okay."
STRATEGY: Parent exploits opponents that have never defected by defecting, repairs after its own recent defections, punishes unprovoked defections, and defects on the final round. Simulated against TFT, always-C, always-D, slot1, slot4, and slot0. Changed to a simple rule: defect if opponent never defected or never cooperated; otherwise cooperate if any of its last 5 actions were D; else punish a D with D; else cooperate.

--- PART 3/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "The general advice says 'begin cooperatively to make mutual cooperation possible' but also mentions maximizing score. Exploiting always C is good for score but might hurt against retaliators slightly."
STRATEGY: Parent is a complex strategy that occasionally defects and scores ~259.5. The trace simulates a simpler candidate: cooperate first, defect while opponent has never defected, then repair for 3 rounds after own recent defection, punish an unprovoked defection, defect on the last round, and defect after five consecutive opponent defections. It changes the parent by replacing its complex logic with this short exploit-and-repair rule.

--- PART 4/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "Use these general suggestions while pursuing the stated tournament objective."
STRATEGY: Parent cooperates initially, defects when opponent has never defected, punishes recent opponent defection, and repairs after its own recent defections. Simulated against slot7, slot8, slot1, TFT, and other population strategies. Changed the repair window from 3 to 5 rounds to avoid re-triggering rate-based strategies.
